---
title: "Makro- & Zentralbank-Dashboard | LUKB"
format:
  html:
    theme: none
    minimal: true
    page-layout: custom
    embed-resources: true
    css: assets/styles.css
---

```{=html}
<div class="lukb-dashboard">

  <!-- Header Section -->
  <header class="lukb-header">
    <div class="lukb-header-top">
      <div class="lukb-title-group">
        <h1>Makro- & Zentralbank-Dashboard</h1>
        <p>Wöchentlicher Konjunkturkalender, anstehende Notenbank-Zinsentscheide und 3-Jahres-Prognosen</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- Navigation / Section Switch (Ohne Gesamtübersicht) -->
  <nav class="lukb-nav">
    <button class="lukb-tab-btn active" data-tab="macro">
      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="0" ry="0"></rect><line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"></line><line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"></line><line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"></line></svg>
      Makrokalender (Laufende Woche)
    </button>
    <button class="lukb-tab-btn" data-tab="cb">
      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M3 21h18M3 10h18M5 10v11M19 10v11M9 10v11M15 10v11M12 2L2 7h20L12 2z"></path></svg>
      Zentralbanktermine (anstehend)
    </button>
    <button class="lukb-tab-btn" data-tab="forecasts">
      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><line x1="18" y1="20" x2="18" y2="10"></line><line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="4"></line><line x1="6" y1="20" x2="6" y2="14"></line></svg>
      BIP- & Inflationsprognosen
    </button>
  </nav>

  <!-- SECTION 1: MAKROKALENDER -->
  <section id="section-macro" class="lukb-card" style="display: block;">
    <div class="lukb-card-header">
      <h2 class="lukb-card-title">
        <span class="icon">📅</span>
        Konjunkturdaten der laufenden Woche
      </h2>
      <div class="lukb-controls">
        <label for="filter-macro-country" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--lukb-blue-900);">Land / Region:</label>
        <select id="filter-macro-country" class="lukb-select">
          <option value="all">Alle Länder / Regionen</option>
          <option value="CH">Schweiz</option>
          <option value="EU">Euroraum</option>
          <option value="DE">Deutschland</option>
          <option value="GB">UK</option>
          <option value="US">USA</option>
          <option value="JP">Japan</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    <!-- Dynamic Table Container (preventing Quarto pandoc table filter issues) -->
    <div class="lukb-card-body">
      <div id="macro-table-container"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="lukb-footer-note">
      <span>Datenquelle: LUKB, LSEG</span>
      <span>Status: Laufende Woche</span>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- SECTION 2: ZENTRALBANKEN -->
  <section id="section-cb" class="lukb-card berry-top" style="display: none;">
    <div class="lukb-card-header">
      <h2 class="lukb-card-title">
        <span class="icon">🏛️</span>
        Zentralbanktermine (Zukünftige Entscheide)
      </h2>
      <div class="lukb-controls">
        <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted);">Automatisch gefiltert ab aktuellem Datum</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Checkbox Filter Panel for Banks -->
    <div class="cb-checkbox-filter-panel">
      <div class="cb-checkbox-header">
        <span>Zentralbanken auswählen:</span>
        <div class="cb-quick-actions">
          <button type="button" id="cb-select-default" class="cb-quick-link">Standard (G5)</button>
          <span>•</span>
          <button type="button" id="cb-select-all" class="cb-quick-link">Alle auswählen</button>
          <span>•</span>
          <button type="button" id="cb-select-none" class="cb-quick-link">Keine</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="cb-checkbox-grid" class="cb-checkbox-grid">
        <!-- Dynamically rendered checkbox chips with sharp borders -->
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- View Switcher Bar (Tabellen-Ansicht vs Kalender-Ansicht) -->
    <div class="cb-view-switch-bar">
      <div class="cb-view-switch-group">
        <button type="button" id="cb-view-table-btn" class="cb-view-switch-btn active" data-view="table">
          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><line x1="8" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"></line><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"></line><line x1="8" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"></line><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="3.01" y2="6"></line><line x1="3" y1="12" x2="3.01" y2="12"></line><line x1="3" y1="18" x2="3.01" y2="18"></line></svg>
          Tabellen-Ansicht
        </button>
        <button type="button" id="cb-view-cal-btn" class="cb-view-switch-btn" data-view="calendar">
          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="0" ry="0"></rect><line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"></line><line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"></line><line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"></line></svg>
          Kalender-Ansicht
        </button>
      </div>
      <div class="cb-view-switch-hint">
        <span>Gitter-Darstellung nach Quartalen (3 Monate pro Zeile)</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Table View Container -->
    <div id="cb-view-table" class="lukb-card-body" style="display: block;">
      <div id="cb-table-container"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Calendar View Container -->
    <div id="cb-view-calendar" class="lukb-card-body" style="display: none; padding: 20px;">
      <div id="cb-calendar-container"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="lukb-footer-note">
      <span>Auswahl: SNB, EZB, Fed, BoE, BoJ, BoC, RBA, Norges Bank, Riksbank, RBNZ</span>
      <span>Filter: Anstehende Termine ab aktuellem Systemdatum (Tabelle) / Jahresübersicht (Kalender)</span>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- SECTION 3: BIP- & INFLATIONSPROGNOSEN -->
  <section id="section-forecasts" class="lukb-card" style="display: none;">
    <div class="lukb-card-header">
      <h2 class="lukb-card-title">
        <span class="icon">📊</span>
        BIP- und Inflationsprognosen
      </h2>
    </div>

    <!-- Dynamic Forecasts Table Container -->
    <div class="lukb-card-body">
      <div id="forecasts-table-container"></div>
    </div>
  </section>

</div>
```
